question: Zika virus was first discovered in 1947 and is named after Zika _____ in Uganda.
solution:
The correct answer is __**forest.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Zika Virus was first identified in **Uganda** in **1947** in **monkeys**.
 
• In 1947, **Scientists conducting routine surveillance** for **yellow fever** in the **Zika forest of Uganda** isolated the **Zika virus** in samples taken from a captive, sentinel rhesus monkey.
 
• In 1948, the virus is recovered from the **mosquito Aedes africanus**, caught on a tree platform in the **Zika forest**.
 
• In 1952, the **first human cases** were **detected** in **Uganda** and the **United Republic of Tanzania** in a study demonstrating neutralizing antibodies to Zika virus in sera.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
